newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia gives off-shore firms greater access.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia gives off-shore firms greater access.

text.p: Off-shore companies established in Tunisia will be allowed greater access for their products as part of a drive to attract foreign investment, Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali said on Saturday.
"We order today that these (offshore) firms be authorised to open sales stores for their products," Ben Ali said in a speech at parliament.
Offshore firms will now be allowed to sell on the domestic market more than the 20 percent production quota previously established, officials said.
They said the decision was taken to give Tunisian and foreign companies producing for export priority access to the domestic market to back up their efforts to create jobs.

More than a thousand companies with foreign capital are currently operating in Tunisia, of which 875 are devoted entirely to exports, mainly in textiles, mechanical and electrical engineering, chemicals and food processing.
